"""Run the frame checks and print the verdict lines the shop board shows."""
import subprocess
import sys

CHECKS = ["frame_alignment", "seam_inspection", "rim_polish", "tube_butting"]


def run(name):
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "checks." + name], capture_output=True)
    return "FAIL" if result.returncode else "PASS"


def main():
    for name in CHECKS:
        print("%s %s" % (run(name), name))
